onboarding.welcome: Welcome! Send me a YouTube, TikTok, X/Twitter, Spotify, or SoundCloud link in any group. I can download videos and music.
onboarding.welcome_pinterest:
👋 Hello!!
📥 I can download videos from Pinterest
👉 Send the link to the bot and in a couple of seconds you will receive a video without a watermark.
onboarding.welcome_spotify:
🎵 Welcome to Spotify Search Tool Bot!

Send me a Spotify album or track link, and I'll download the tracks for you.

Examples:
• https://open.spotify.com/album/...
• https://open.spotify.com/track/...

Just paste the link — I'll handle the rest.
onboarding.welcome_soundcloud:
🎧 Welcome to SoundCloud Downloader Bot!

Send me a SoundCloud track or playlist link, and I'll download the tracks for you.

Examples:
• https://soundcloud.com/artist/track
• https://soundcloud.com/artist/sets/playlist

Just paste the link — I'll handle the rest.
